# GTS segment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:gtsSegment`](gmeow-gtsSegment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/gtsSegment>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A segment of this GTS document — the inverse of [`gmeow:gtsSegmentOf`](gmeow-gtsSegmentOf.md). Non-functional: a document holds one or more segments, ordered by [`gmeow:gtsSegmentIndex`](gmeow-gtsSegmentIndex.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:GTSDocument`](../classes/gmeow-GTSDocument.md) -> [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:gtsSegment`](gmeow-gtsSegment.md) from [`gmeow:GTSDocument`](../classes/gmeow-GTSDocument.md) to [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use in document-rooted projections and traversals — when enumerating a document's segments from the document side is the natural direction to state or query.

### Avoid when

- Avoid relying on it for segment order (that is [`gmeow:gtsSegmentIndex`](gmeow-gtsSegmentIndex.md)) and avoid asserting it directly when minting a segment; prefer stating [`gmeow:gtsSegmentOf`](gmeow-gtsSegmentOf.md) and reading this as its inverse.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:gtsSegmentOf`](gmeow-gtsSegmentOf.md) from each segment and read [`gmeow:gtsSegment`](gmeow-gtsSegment.md) as the inverse; pair with [`gmeow:gtsSegmentIndex`](gmeow-gtsSegmentIndex.md) to recover the file order that fixes the document's composite identity.

### Examples

- ex:bundle [`gmeow:gtsSegment`](gmeow-gtsSegment.md) ex:seg0, ex:seg1.
